forms.name: satellite

pipes.name: LVK_GWTC5
pipes.statement: LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA GWTC-5.0 (released 2026-05-26): 390 confirmed events, 161 new from O4b
pipes.why: Updates strong-field GR and remnant statistics. Does not speak 1/r^4.
pipes.can_kill: a claim that binary black holes are not seen; a wrong remnant-mass formula
pipes.cannot: Track B regularity; inverse-GCD; F; nodes.json

pipes.name: EHT_M87
pipes.statement: EHT M87* 2021-epoch papers (2026): stable ring, evolving polarization, jet-base hint
pipes.why: Image + visibility (holographic reconstruction of an image). Horizon-scale plasma. Not HB Experiment 01.
pipes.can_kill: a claim that M87* has no ring; a zero-spin MAD model at the margin
pipes.cannot: retune nodes.json; write F; close NS; prove primes

pipes.name: DESI_DR2
pipes.statement: DESI DR2 BAO (2025): 14M galaxies; ΛCDM challenged at ~3σ when combined; Σm_ν < 0.064 eV (ΛCDM)
pipes.why: Satellite-adjacent cosmology. Preference for w0wa is a tension, not F. Bayesian caution exists.
pipes.can_kill: a claim that Λ is unchallengeable; Cosmo 0.06 eV as a derivation if it misses the bound
pipes.cannot: produce (g_s,g,g'); Track A or B; primes

pipes.name: IPTA_NANOGrav
pipes.statement: IPTA-DR3 + NANOGrav 15 yr: nHz background, spectrum still being reconstructed (2026 PPL paper)
pipes.why: Time series from radio telescopes (not LVK band). Common-spectrum process. Source still open.
pipes.can_kill: a claim that there is no nHz common-spectrum process
pipes.cannot: identify the source as HB; close nature4

pipes.name: PDG_LHC
pipes.statement: PDG + LHC run updates: the numbers L_SM consumes
pipes.why: Already on the dream team as nature. The pipe keeps the table current.
pipes.can_kill: a poster number that drifts outside PDG error

pipes.name: LMFDB_NT
pipes.statement: LMFDB + arXiv math.NT: L-functions, modular forms, prime-gap records (unconditional H=246 still stands)
pipes.why: The arithmetic stream. Heuristic gap papers are not theorems. Twin primes still open.
pipes.can_kill: a false λ_min(Q_N)>-1/2 for all N; a wrong L-function table

pipes.name: arXiv_math_AP
pipes.statement: arXiv math.AP / fluids: new lemmas may sit on B if they keep 1/r^4 and name a check
pipes.why: A preprint is not a regularity pass. It is a proposal the Track B checker may score.
pipes.can_kill: a B lemma whose identity fails on a named field
pipes.cannot: close domain B by press release

pipes.name: Euclid_JWST_Planck
pipes.statement: Euclid / JWST / Planck–ACT–SPT: maps and spectra of the sky
pipes.why: Satellite and space-telescope forms. Update H0/Λ/structure tensions. Not Cosmo F.
pipes.can_kill: a cosmology number outside the current tension box

pipes.name: IceCube_neutrino
pipes.statement: IceCube / KM3NeT / oscillation data: Σm_ν and astrophysical neutrinos
pipes.why: Nature already sat as neutrino/cosmology. The pipe is the refresh.
pipes.can_kill: a Σm_ν claim that misses the DESI+CMB bound

verdicts.name: B1_low_flux
verdicts.why: Identity. Try to falsify: exhibit a periodic div-free field where the integral is not zero.
verdicts.if_survives: still just an identity, not regularity

verdicts.name: B_regularity
verdicts.why: Not a pass. Killer of the open: a closed estimate for X. Fake pass killer: any BKM-from-L2 slogan.
verdicts.killer: closed bound on X, or a proven blowup

verdicts.name: B4b_Itube
verdicts.why: The live tube write. Falsify the hope: a data class where the wall term wins.
verdicts.killer: a tube family with wall ≳ I_tube at δ ~ 2^{-j*}

verdicts.name: A_theorem
verdicts.statement: Track A pass for this PDE, ε>0
verdicts.why: Try to falsify: break the energy identity or uniqueness at fixed ε>0. ε→0 is not this claim.
verdicts.killer: Galerkin energy identity fails, or two H^1 solutions at the same ε
verdicts.if_killed: Theorem A withdrawn for this write

verdicts.name: Q_full_floor
verdicts.why: Already killed. Resurrection: a proof for all N, against the known counterexamples.

verdicts.name: F_exists
verdicts.why: Affine holdout already lost. Resurrection: a public F with χ²_ext ≤ ε².
verdicts.if_killed: stays fail until a new F is written and beaten against the null

verdicts.name: destination_spectrum
verdicts.why: Falsify the destination-as-done: we already did (no named D). Falsify the destination-as-program: show no operator can have those numbers as eigenvalues — that is a different, harder kill.
verdicts.killer: named D whose eigenvalues are the couplings, or a no-go theorem

verdicts.name: hb_exp01

verdicts.why: Already run. Resurrection would be a new protocol, not a retune of nodes.json.

inferences: A kill stays in its slot. LVK does not move B. LMFDB does not move U couplings.
Same word 'spectrum' is not an edge. CMB, QNM, and L-functions stay unentangled.
A survived kill on a pass is still a pass, not truth (wave rule).
A fail with no resurrection on the desk stays fail (F, full Q floor, HB Exp 01).
New catalogs update the now-bench and U numbers-as-inputs. They do not write F.
DESI tension: Λ is challengeable as a model, still not an output of L_SM.
GWTC-5.0: black holes are seen in strain. That is not 1/r^4 and not primes.

nine pipes dated; GWTC-5.0, EHT 2026, DESI DR2, IPTA-DR3, LMFDB, PDG, AP, Euclid/JWST, IceCube
